origin.description: Files in a directory with one of the given extensions.
origin.usage: list_files_with_exts(dir, exts, all.files = FALSE, full.names = TRUE)

arguments.name: all.files
arguments.text: Include names that start with a dot.

arguments.name: full.names
arguments.text: Return paths instead of bare names.

origin.details: The extension test is a regular expression. A dot inside an extension such as tab.gz is not escaped, so it matches any character. Names are sorted.
origin.value: A character vector of names or paths.
origin.example: dir <- tempfile(); dir.create(dir); writeLines("z", file.path(dir, "a.R")); list_files_with_exts(dir, "R", full.names = FALSE)

translation.description: Files in a directory with one of the given extensions.

arguments.name: all.files
arguments.text: Include names that start with a dot.

arguments.name: full.names
arguments.text: Return paths instead of bare names.

translation.details: Same pattern as R: dots inside exts are not escaped. Names are sorted, and a leading dot is hidden unless all_files is true.
translation.value: A list of names or paths.
translation.example:
import os, tempfile
from tools import list_files_with_exts
directory = tempfile.mkdtemp()
open(os.path.join(directory, "a.R"), "w").write("z\n")
print(list_files_with_exts(directory, "R", full_names=False))
